    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/^https?:\/\//, '')
    .split('/')[0]
    .split('?')[0]
    .split('#')[0]
    .replace(/:\d+$/, '')
    .replace(/\.$/, '')
    .replace(/\/+$/, '')

  return value || null
}

const beforeChange: CollectionBeforeChangeHook = async ({ data, req, originalDoc }) =&gt; {
  if (!data) return data

  // Normalize domains while preserving subdomains.
  // This keeps explicit entries like &#96;cms.example.com&#96; and &#96;www.example.com&#96;
  // visible in admin instead of collapsing them into &#96;example.com&#96;.
  if (Array.isArray(data.domains)) {
    data.domains = data.domains
      .map((d: any) =&gt; {
        let raw: string | null = null
        if (typeof d === 'string') {
          raw = d
        } else if (d &amp;&amp; typeof d === 'object' &amp;&amp; typeof d.domain === 'string') {
          raw = d.domain
        }

        if (!raw) return null

        const normalized = normalizeDomainPreserveSubdomain(raw)
        if (!normalized) return null

        return { domain: normalized }
      })
      .filter((d: any) =&gt; d !== null)

    // Deduplicate normalized domains inside the same Site

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TAG="${1:-latest}"
STACK_FILE="docker-stack-payload.yml"

source "./scripts/lib/env-guardrails.sh"

load_env_file
require_stack_envs "${STACK_FILE}"

IMAGE="$(current_image_from_stack "${STACK_FILE}")"
[[ -n "${IMAGE}" ]] || fail "Could not resolve image from ${STACK_FILE}"

GIT_COMMIT_HASH="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2&gt;/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"

echo "Building image ${IMAGE}:${TAG} (git: ${GIT_COMMIT_HASH})"
docker build \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT_HASH="${GIT_COMMIT_HASH}" \
  -t "${IMAGE}:${TAG}" \
  .
echo "Build complete: ${IMAGE}:${TAG}"

```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TAG="${1:-latest}"
STACK_FILE="docker-stack-payload.yml"

source "./scripts/lib/env-guardrails.sh"

IMAGE="$(current_image_from_stack "${STACK_FILE}")"
[[ -n "${IMAGE}" ]] || fail "Could not resolve image from ${STACK_FILE}"

echo "Pushing image ${IMAGE}:${TAG}"
docker push "${IMAGE}:${TAG}"

if [[ "${TAG}" != "latest" ]]; then
  echo "Tagging ${IMAGE}:${TAG} as ${IMAGE}:latest"
  docker tag "${IMAGE}:${TAG}" "${IMAGE}:latest"
  docker push "${IMAGE}:latest"
fi

echo "Push complete for ${IMAGE}:${TAG}"

```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Guarded Swarm deploy for payload-swarm ONLY.
# Always use this (or ./scripts/deploy.sh) — never raw &#96;docker stack deploy&#96; without loading .env.production,
# or Docker will interpolate ${DATABASE_URI} as empty and break the service.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." &amp;&amp; pwd)"
cd "${ROOT}"

source "${ROOT}/scripts/lib/env-guardrails.sh"

load_env_file
require_stack_envs "docker-stack-payload.yml"
require_env "DATABASE_URI"
require_env "PAYLOAD_SECRET"
require_env "INTERNAL_LINKER_API_KEY"
require_local_database "DATABASE_URI"

echo "Deploying stack payload-swarm (validated env + DATABASE_URI)"
docker stack deploy -c "${ROOT}/docker-stack-payload.yml" --with-registry-auth "payload-swarm"

# CRITICAL: Post-deploy verification - ensure Docker actually received the DATABASE_URI
echo "Waiting for service spec to update..."
sleep 3

verify_runtime_database "payload-swarm_payload" "DATABASE_URI"
echo "POST-DEPLOY VERIFICATION PASSED: DATABASE_URI confirmed in running service spec"

```

_**Agent (claude-4.6-sonnet-medium-thinking)**_

Every count matches. The deployment is fully live. Here's what was happening and what was fixed:

**Root cause:** The TypeScript collection files (`Categories.ts`, `Tags.ts`) were updated in the previous session with the new fields, but the Payload Docker service was still running the **old image** — which meant the API didn't serve `group`, `url_segment`, `sort_order`, or `description`. BlogCraft's taxonomy sync couldn't see these fields and likely received unexpected/empty data.

**What was done:**
1. **Rebuilt** the Docker image with the updated collections (`payload-swarm:latest`)
2. **Pushed** to the registry and **deployed** via the guarded stack deploy script
3. **Rolled** all 3 service replicas to the new image

**All fields now live in the API:**
- `categories`: `url_segment`, `sort_order`, `description` ✅
- `tags`: `group`, `description` ✅

**Live API counts (all pass):** 7 categories · 92 tags · all 8 group buckets correct.

You can now retry the taxonomy sync in BlogCraft for CompareITAD — it should find all 7 categories and 92 tags correctly.
